title: Bigu lesson content
description: Shape of a data/lessons.json file, as loaded by js/views/lessons.js. This is the one content file that is a bare array rather than an object with an updatedAt — a lesson is a place in the textbook, so the file is the spine itself with nothing wrapped around it.

lesson.description: The textbook lesson number, following みんなの日本語 order. This is the lesson's identity — lessons carry no id, because they are not studiable items and never become a progress-store key.

title.description: Lesson title, conventionally the Japanese followed by a gloss in parentheses. May be an empty string: the spine runs to lesson 50 and is filled in by hand as each is studied, so an untitled lesson is a lesson not yet written down. That is a normal state in this app rather than a gap to be closed under pressure, and the schema does not treat it as an error.

grammar.description: Optional list of grammar points introduced by this lesson, as plain strings. May be empty for a lesson whose grammar has not been written down yet.

words.description: The lesson's own word list. May be empty — a lesson not yet written down appears without content, which is a normal state rather than a gap. It must still be an array: the flattened pool every study surface draws from is built out of these lists, so one missing takes the whole review pool with it.

id.description: Unique id in the form "l<lesson>-<nn>", e.g. "l12-04". Used as the progress-store key, and the prefix js/study/decks.js routes to the lessons deck — an id in any other shape is an item no round will ever ask about.

word.description: The headword as written, kanji included where the textbook uses them.

reading.description: Kana reading. Equal to `word` for words already written in kana — the quiz reads that equality as "there is no separate reading" and draws no furigana.

english.description: The gloss the reader is learning. Named `english` for historical reasons; the catalogue's glosses are Mongolian, and the field name is left alone because it is read by js/ui/quiz.js's lessons adapter and appears in every backup ever downloaded.
